description:
Refactor the 'CityWeather' Android project to secure a hardcoded API key.

1. Locate the hardcoded API key in 'app/src/main/java/com/example/cityweather/network/WeatherService.kt'.
2. Move the key to the 'local.properties' file in the root directory as 'WEATHER_API_KEY'.
3. Configure 'app/build.gradle.kts' to read this property from 'local.properties' and inject it into the generated BuildConfig class using 'buildConfigField'.
4. Update 'WeatherService.kt' to reference 'BuildConfig.WEATHER_API_KEY' instead of the hardcoded string.
5. Verify the project builds successfully.
